observations: Supported witnesses retain all labels and expected pagination, column positions, spanner backgrounds and following flow against Edge.

Final three rule contacts have rules only between adjacent occupied columns in each physical band; extra earlier-band rules and the single-column continuation rule are removed. Solid-blue rule geometry accepted separately with actual before evidence.
Max-height overlap of following flow is native behavior and remains intact while continued text survives.
balance-max-height-60 is an explicit diagnosed fallback with AFTER placement difference; no qualified match is asserted.
All five SVG printcontacts inspected at96dpi, representing9cases/34print+screenimagepages via exactcontactbyteequivalence.
Font antialiasing and single-pixel slice endpoints remain visible in native comparisons; no exact browser raster identity claim.
limits: Continuous fullpage independent raster oracle not established; native DOM geometry separately checked.
ScreenSnapshotPaged is fixed canvas slicing after continuous layout, not fragmented reflow.

columnRules.policy: Targeted solid-blue rule witness only: adjacent connected vertical stroke groups, center and interval endpoints within1pixel at96dpi; ignore isolated one-pixel Edge slice endpoint. This does not replace full unmasked SVG raster/label/page comparison or visual inspection.

svg.rasterPolicy: Independent Poppler rasterization of native Edge SVG PDFs and qualified product PDFs at actual normal 96dpi. Whole unmasked pages, same-origin white padding for page rounding only; no crop, scaling, registration, mask or synthetic scene PNG. Raw MAE and difference maps remain descriptive.

remainingBoundary: Descendant and fragmented spanners, spanner-owned break/keep directives and wider page/column forced-break combinations remain outside this qualified subset.

Balanced spanning overflow retains diagnosed paint/following-flow approximation in PrintPaged and ScreenMediaPaged for balance-max-height-60. ScreenFullPage and ScreenSnapshotPaged retain native-derived continuous geometry without this warning.
Nested column regions, changing or reserved page geometry, tall notes/figures, floats, specialized hosts and height-dependent alignment retain their separate open qualification boundaries.

Continuous DOM, glyph geometry, native PDF and selected SVG raster witnesses qualify different surfaces; no general browser raster identity, arbitrary page fidelity or complete multicolumn implementation is claimed.

Original reused native lifecycle receipts do not independently hash every font byte at acquisition. Exact current repository/input font hashes and native output/reuse chains are retained; historical provenance is not strengthened retroactively.

Unsigned private package consumers and legacy compile proof do not establish Windows execution, public package publication, deployment, hosted CI/review, manual accessibility or broader runtime/provider adoption.

reproduction.fixtures: Place a selected checked-in HTML fixture and the two exact repository fonts from assetMap into a temporary directory as index.html, regular.ttf and bold.ttf. Fonts remain referenced repository assets; no font binaries are duplicated in the fixture directory.
reproduction.managedConfiguration: Browser UA; exact bundled Witness regular/bold fonts; no host fallback or external resources. Viewport800x1000; CSS page700x140px, margin20px; individual fixtures declare their own finite heights, line sizes and column geometry.
reproduction.nativeConfiguration: Canonical HtmlTinkerX BrowserProbe and Microsoft Edge; loopback served inputs, font readiness, print/screen-media PDFs and DOM geometry. Reused native artifacts and original browser/server lifecycle receipts remain separately bound.
reproduction.pixelPolicy: Native SVG and managed PDF use whole unmasked Poppler96dpi pages; same-origin white padding for page rounding only. No crop, scale, registration or mask. Glyph geometry uses the recorded0.05CSSpx tolerance; raw raster differences remain descriptive.
